summary: Specifies the QCP file format, which many implementations already used to store QCELP 13K speech and also EVRC and SMV vocoder data. RFC 2658 covered the streaming format but not storage. This document also updates the audio/qcelp media type and registers audio/evrc-qcp and audio/smv-qcp.

eli5.summary: Voice recordings need a box to be saved in. This document describes a box many programs already used, so everyone can save phone voice recordings the same way and open each other's files.

questions: what is the qcp file format
